truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 identified 10 of 20 true vulnerabilities, missed 10, and had severity/CWE mismatches on 4 items. No false positives were found in Run 1 — all its findings were supported by the source, though two (safe_string_copy off-by-one and malloc null deref) were not in the ground-truth list.

Items.Notes: Run 1 explicitly identified the format-string vulnerability in log_debug_message with CWE-134. The evidence quote matches the source anchor printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input). Severity was rated High instead of Critical, but the vulnerability was fully found.
Run 1 made no mention of integer overflow in the factorial computation (result *= i in the fact lambda). This vulnerability was completely absent from the previous findings.
Run 1 did not identify the use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush where scratch allocated from g_memory_pool is used asynchronously after g_memory_pool.cleanup() is called in cleanup().

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: std::string command = validator_cmd + " " + config_file;\nint result = system(command.c_str());
Items.Notes: Run 1 explicitly found the command injection via ConfigLoader::validate_config with CWE-78. The evidence quote matches the source. Severity was rated High instead of Critical, but the vulnerability was fully identified.
Run 1 identified the stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression using strcpy when expression length >= sizeof(input_buffer_). CWE-120 and severity High match.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: long long old_value = value_;\nstd::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);\nvalue_ = old_value + 1;
Items.Notes: Run 1 correctly identified the race condition in ThreadSafeCounter::increment with CWE-362 and severity Medium, quoting the exact vulnerable pattern.
Run 1 did not identify the logic bomb in authentication where login_attempts_ > 5 combined with EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypasses authentication (authenticated_ = true).
Run 1 did not identify path traversal in ConfigLoader::load_config where config_dir_ + filename is used without sanitization.

Run 1 identified a buffer overflow via strcpy in ExpressionParser::parse but classified it as CWE-120 with severity High. The true vulnerability is CWE-122 (heap overflow, since expression_buffer_ is heap-allocated from g_memory_pool) with severity Critical. The vulnerability was found but with incorrect CWE and severity.
Run 1 identified the hardcoded admin secret with CWE-798 but rated severity Medium instead of High. The vulnerability was found but severity was underclaimed.

Run 1 identified weak session token generation but used CWE-330 instead of CWE-338 and rated severity Medium instead of High. The vulnerability pattern was found but with incorrect CWE classification and severity.
Run 1 did not identify the thread-unsafe timestamp cache using static std::tm cached_time with localtime() in log_debug_message.
Run 1 did not identify insecure temporary file handling in append_override_audit_event using TEMP/TMPDIR env vars with system() command construction.
Run 1 did not identify persistent authentication state (CWE-613) where authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ persist across operations without proper invalidation.
Run 1 did not identify the unhandled exception in handle_variable_command where std::stod(tokens[3]) can throw if tokens[3] is not a valid number.
Run 1 did not identify integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate where previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES can underflow when previous_size is small.
Run 1 did not identify unbounded recursion in parse_expression -> parse_factor -> parse_expression with no depth limit despite MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH being defined.
Run 1 did not identify the data race in result_cache_ where evaluate_cached accesses the cache without holding cache_mutex_ while another thread may be writing via thread_pool_->enqueue.
Run 1 did not identify the TOCTOU race in ConfigLoader::load_config between std::filesystem::exists check and subsequent std::ifstream file open, compounded by an intentional sleep_for delay.
Run 1 correctly identified division by zero in calculate_route_score with CWE-369 and severity Low, matching the ground truth.
